youtube_description:
We analysed a portion of Gary Vaynerchuk's interview with Seth Godin, referencing science. We measured speaking rate, distinct emotions like frustration, sadness, happiness etc. but also arousal and positivity. The conversation is very interesting and lively and we were happy to put it to the test through our Behavioral Signals callER engine and create a video showcasing our results.
Look for the whole interview under #AskGaryVee Episode 185: Seth Godin on Thought Leaders, Psychics & The Future of the Internet.
